services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Looking for the top spot for Nashville boat rentals? Cedar Creek Marina is your gateway to adventure on Old Hickory Lake, just a short drive from downtown Nashville. Whether you’re planning a relaxing day on the water or a lively group outing, our marina is the perfect starting point for discovering this scenic Tennessee destination. As one of the most trusted providers of Old Hickory pontoon rentals, we offer well-maintained boats ideal for family outings, fishing trips, and unforgettable lake days with friends. Cruise through quiet coves, drop anchor near sandy shorelines, or cast a line at some of the lake’s best fishing spots. With easy access, convenient parking, and helpful dock

blurb: Cedar Creek Marina provides boat rentals for cruising, watersports, and fishing on Old Hickory Lake. They offer wet slips for vessels up to 80 feet and unique waterfront lodging options including vacation home rentals and floating cabins. The marina features a fully stocked ship's store and fuel dock for convenience.
